title: fix(plugin-sharing): the record-share grant names each non-user value's sharing-rule recipient, so `group` is sent to `team`
body:
Fixes #23325

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`ISharingService.grant` writes a record share for a `user` only (ADR-0078). It refused every other declared value with one remedy:

> VALIDATION_FAILED: recipientType must be 'user' (received "group") — group/position recipients are delivered via sharing rules (ADR-0111 D7)

The sharing-rule vocabulary has no `group`. Neither the authoring `sharedWith.type` enum (`ShareRecipientType`, `packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts:126`) nor the `sys_sharing_rule.recipient_type` select (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-sharing-rule.object.ts:172`) offers it. A rule spells it `team`: the v17 ADR-0087 entry `sharing-rule-recipient-reconcile` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.sharing-rule-recipient-reconcile.ts:11`) records "`group` → `team`" as the ADR-0090 D3 rename. A caller or an AI that followed the remedy wrote a rule naming a recipient no rule takes. A `unit_and_subordinates` caller read a sentence that did not name its value.

## What changed

`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`:

- `RULE_ROUTE_BY_RECORD_SHARE_RECIPIENT` names, for each declared non-`user` value, the rule recipient that delivers it. It is typed against both vocabularies rather than restating either as a second runtime list:
  - keys are every `RecordShareRecipientType` member except `user` (the union with `user` excluded, as a TypeScript `Record` key type), so a record-share member added in the spec fails to compile here until it names its route;
  - values are the authorable `ShareRecipientType` (the list the `sys_sharing_rule` select is held equal to by `field-recipient.test.ts`), so the refusal can never name a recipient a rule cannot be written with. The reserved `queue` is excluded by construction.
- The refusal keeps its code, its 400 (the `VALIDATION_FAILED` prefix arm, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:11301`) and its first clause. Only the remedy after the dash changes:

| received | remedy, TO |
|---|---|
| `group` | a group recipient is delivered via a sharing rule with recipient type 'team', its name since the ADR-0090 D3 rename (ADR-0111 D7) |
| `position` | a position recipient is delivered via a sharing rule with recipient type 'position' (ADR-0111 D7) |
| `unit_and_subordinates` | a unit_and_subordinates recipient is delivered via a sharing rule with recipient type 'unit_and_subordinates' (ADR-0111 D7) |
| a value no record share declares (an untyped REST body sending `team`, say) | "team" is not a record-share recipient type (ADR-0111 D7) |

- The retired `guest` keeps its own prescription (ADR-0138 D8), byte for byte.
- ⛔ No change to which values `grant()` accepts (`user` only), and none to the record-share vocabulary.

`content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sharing-service.mdx` (Typical Errors, `VALIDATION_FAILED`) stated the old remedy. It now states the per-value mapping. **This file is outside the claim's declared file surface.** The dispatch asked that everything in this repo stating the old remedy be updated, and this was the one other hit.

`.changeset/23325-record-share-remedy-text.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`. The sentence ships: after the build, `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs` each hold the new undeclared-value text once and the old sentence zero times, with the guest prescription as positive control (1 each). `files[]` is `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`.

## Measured before writing (on `origin/main` at `cad343e201`, re-read after merging `5477020809`)

- **Premise holds.** The sentence was at `sharing-service.ts:1396-1397`. The existing pin `refuses non-user recipient types instead of persisting rows no gate reads` asserted `VALIDATION_FAILED` only, never the remedy.
- **No declared value lacks a rule route.** The record-share vocabulary is `user`, `group`, `position`, `unit_and_subordinates` (`RecordShareRecipientType`, and the `sys_record_share` select). The rule vocabulary is `user`, `team`, `business_unit`, `position`, `unit_and_subordinates`, `field`. `group` maps to `team` by the recorded rename. The other two keep their own names.
- **Where the old remedy was stated or asserted:** `git grep` for the sentence and its phrases hits only `sharing-service.ts` and the docs line above in this repo. There are zero hits in the i18n bundles. In `objectstack-ai/objectui` at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `b9814b334d` there are zero hits. The control word `recipientType` does hit there, for example `packages/fields/src/widgets/RecipientPickerField.tsx` (8 hits). Nothing outside this repo states it.
- **On the citation.** ADR-0090 D3's own rename table lists `role` → `position`, not `group` → `team`. D3's naming commandment reads "collaboration = `team`". The spec's `ShareRecipientType` docblock ("ADR-0090 D3 renamed the pre-D3 `group` vocabulary to `team`") and the v17 entry attribute the rename to D3. The remedy cites "the ADR-0090 D3 rename", as triage directed, which matches the repository's own record.

## Pins

`sharing-service.test.ts`, describe `[ADR-0111 D7] the refusal names the sharing-rule recipient that delivers each non-user value`, following the pattern PR #23324 set for `guest`:

- `covers exactly the non-user values a record-share row declares, and routes each to a rule recipient`: the table's keys equal the `sys_record_share` select's non-`user` options. Each route is an option of the `sys_sharing_rule` select, and `group` is not.
- `group → … 'team'`, `position → … 'position'`, `unit_and_subordinates → … 'unit_and_subordinates'`: the code prefix and the received value, the named rule recipient, the `(ADR-0111 D7)` ending, and that nothing is written.
- `group's remedy cites the rename and never names a group rule recipient`. The other two carry no rename clause.
- `a value no record share declares is told so, and is named no route`: `team`, the exact sentence, no "delivered via".
- The guest pin's guard widens from `/sharing rules/` to `/sharing rule/`, so that it still catches a remedy naming a rule route under the new singular wording. The guest message itself is unchanged.

### Ablation (one-off, committed fix first; nothing left in the tree)

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` swapped `+ nonUserRecipientTypeRemedy(recipientType),` for the old sentence. It recorded anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `52704b19f94e` → `97ac1ab79692`. It then ran `vitest run src/sharing-service.test.ts -t 'inert grants'`, with the test importing `./sharing-service.js` from source (no dist in the path):

- **Mutated: 5 failed.** The three per-value cases, the rename case, and the undeclared-value case. For example: `Received: "VALIDATION_FAILED: recipientType must be 'user' (received "team") — group/position recipients are delivered via sharing rules (ADR-0111 D7)"`.
- **Green under the mutation, as predicted:** the vocabulary-coverage case (it reads the selects, not the message), the pre-existing refusal pin, and the guest pin.
- **Restored:** `git checkout HEAD -- …`. Blob after restore `52704b19f94e` = HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. Old-sentence count 0, new-call count 1.

## Tests (at `6f42b8d08a`, the head this PR opens with)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 46 files, 1067 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck` (tsc, tsconfig.scripts.json, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `sharing-service.test.ts` is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit, 46 test files), with no debt entry.
- Dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-sharing^...' build`: exit 0. It was rebuilt after the merge of `origin/main`, which brought a `packages/core` change.
- The require entry `dist/index.js` loads (`require()` → 62 exports).

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `6f42b8d08a`: 95 commands for 4 paths. Each was run byte for byte, with its exit captured before any pipe.

- **92 exit 0 on the first pass.** 3 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` needed `client`/`client-react` dist. Built, re-run: exit 0, "263 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)".
  - `pnpm check:i18n` needed the CLI's extract closure. Built with the command the gate prints, re-run: exit 0, "OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)".
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` **NOT MEASURED**: it needs every package's dist (57 named missing). That whole-tree build is CI's. The one package this diff touches was measured by hand above: its require entry loads, and the diff adds only type-only imports, which are erased.
- **`--ran` reconciliation:** "95 derived, 94 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- **One `UNRECOGNISED` line, verbatim, from `pnpm check:engine-double-contract`** (a verdict, not a failure): `UNRECOGNISED [engine-double-contract]: 22 construct(s) in packages, examples declare a scanned verb (delete, update, findOne) alongside engine siblings, and this gate could not read the implementation -- so they are in NEITHER the pinned population nor the ledger. 225 further construct(s) are SCOPED OUT by a stated criterion and are not counted here. This is a verdict, not a finding: it never fails a run (#9747, ruling of 2026-08-18).`
- CI's own families are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- A caller that sends a rule spelling to the record-share door (`team`, `business_unit`, `field`) is told the value is not a record-share recipient type. It is deliberately not routed: the card scopes the remedy to declared record-share values, and routing undeclared ones would mean a second read of the rule vocabulary at this door.
- A sharing rule shares the records its criteria match. A caller who meant one record for a team needs a criteria naming that record. The remedy names the rule recipient only, as the card asks.
- `SharingRuleService.defineRule` does not check the recipient type itself; it relies on the `sys_sharing_rule` select at insert. This is read from source only and not measured at a public door, so it is not filed.
